title: Insurance Lead Generator
description:
Fully Remote Available Up to £45,000 Basic + Generous Bonus Leeds-Based Independent Broker

A lead generation role where quality matters more than call statistics.

If you're good at generating new business opportunities but frustrated by unrealistic call targets, poor-quality data or pressure to book appointments for the sake of it, this could be worth a conversation.

I'm recruiting for a growing independent commercial insurance broker that's looking for an experienced Contact Manager to help develop its commercial business.

This isn't a typical high-volume telesales position.

They're not expecting you to make 150-200 calls a day or fill an Account Executive's diary with meetings that have little chance of going anywhere.

They'd much rather you research a business properly, understand who you're speaking to and have a worthwhile conversation that could eventually lead to a new client.

They appreciate that good opportunities take time to develop, particularly in commercial insurance, where renewal dates and established relationships play such an important part.

And importantly, you'll be rewarded for the results you deliver.

What would you be doing?

You'll be working closely with experienced Commercial Account Executives, identifying businesses that could benefit from reviewing their insurance arrangements.

The good news is that you won't be starting from scratch.

The company already has an established, cleansed database of business contacts and insurance renewal dates, giving you a strong starting point.

Alongside developing these existing prospects, you'll also research and identify new businesses to approach, with a particular interest in growing their presence within the construction sector.

Your role will involve identifying the right decision-makers, understanding their business and insurance renewal dates, developing relationships and arranging qualified appointments.

And when it comes to what constitutes a good appointment, they're sensible.

They're not expecting you to complete a full insurance review before arranging a meeting. At a minimum, they're looking for a genuine prospect who's open to discussing their arrangements at renewal, with some understanding of what might encourage them to consider another broker.

The more information you can obtain, the better, but they recognise that every opportunity is different.

Ultimately, they want someone who understands the difference between a name in a diary and a genuine commercial opportunity.

Who are they looking for?

Ideally, you'll already have experience generating new business opportunities within commercial insurance.

You'll understand how the renewal cycle works, be comfortable talking to business owners and decision-makers, and have a proven track record of identifying opportunities that result in new business.

For someone who can demonstrate this experience and success, there's a basic salary of up to circa £45,000 available.

However, insurance experience isn't essential.

They're also interested in speaking with successful B2 B lead generation professionals who have a consultative approach, strong research skills and the ability to build relationships with senior decision-makers.

For someone coming from outside insurance, the salary is likely to be around £35,000, although there's flexibility for an exceptional candidate.

What matters most is that you're commercially aware, naturally curious, confident on the telephone and genuinely enjoy the challenge of opening doors.

A role you can make your own

The company has already enjoyed considerable success with its lead generation function and recognises just how important the right person can be to its growth.

This is a key appointment, rather than simply another person being brought in to make calls.

They're equally happy to recruit someone who wants to establish themselves as a successful, well-rewarded Contact Manager for the long term, or someone who has ambitions to develop into a client-facing Commercial Account Executive role.

There's no expectation that you have to move into an Account Executive position to progress or be valued.

If you're excellent at generating opportunities and want to continue doing that, they'll appreciate what you bring.

Equally, if your longer-term ambitions involve managing clients and developing your own portfolio, it's a business where that conversation can be had.

What's on offer?
- Up to £45,000 basic salary for someone with a successful track record in commercial insurance lead generation.
- Generous bonus scheme, rewarding you for qualified appointments and paying a percentage of income generated from successful new business.
- Fully remote working available, with the option to spend time in the office on the outskirts of Leeds if you're local. Free parking is available.
- An existing, cleansed database of business contacts and insurance renewal dates.
- The opportunity to develop new prospect relationships, particularly within construction.
- Sensible, commercially focused expectations rather than excessive call-volume targets.
- A growing independent broker that recognises and rewards the contribution of its people.
- The opportunity to build a long-term career in lead generation or potentially develop towards an Account Executive position, depending on your ambitions.

Interested?

If you're already successful in commercial insurance lead generation but feel you could achieve more with the right backing, realistic expectations and a rewarding bonus structure, I'd be particularly interested in speaking with you.

Equally, if you've developed a strong track record in B2 B lead generation and fancy applying those skills within commercial insurance, this could be an excellent opportunity.

You don't need to be actively looking for something new.

Get in touch for a confidential conversation, and I'll happily explain more about the business, the people involved and what they're looking to achieve.

title: Internal Sales, Leeds
description:

At ASD, we are one of the UK's leading metal stockholders and processing specialists, supplying high-quality steel and metal products to customers across a wide range of industries. Built on expertise, innovation and long-term partnerships, we help our customers succeed while driving positive change for our colleagues, communities and the environment.

This fast-paced, customer-focused role involves managing customer accounts, responding to enquiries, preparing quotations and identifying opportunities to grow profitable sales. You will build long-term customer relationships, understand their requirements and provide the right products and solutions, working closely with customers and our External Sales team to develop accounts and win new business.

This is an excellent opportunity for a motivated sales professional who thrives in a busy commercial environment.

We are interested in candidates with the drive, resilience and commercial awareness to succeed in sales.

Ideally, you will have:

- The ability to build customer relationships and identify sales opportunities
- Strong commercial awareness and a target-driven approach
- Excellent communication, negotiation and influencing skills

- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities

What's In It For You?

We recognise that great people make great businesses. You will receive a competitive salary and benefits package, including:

title: Sales Executive
description:
We're looking for a driven, outgoing and ambitious Sales Executive to join our growing team, helping customers find the right solar panel and battery storage solutions for their homes.

You'll be speaking to customers who have already expressed an interest in solar and battery storage, understanding what they're looking for, helping put together a suitable solution and guiding them through to a sale.

You don't need previous experience in solar, batteries or renewable energy. Full training will be provided. What matters most is your ability to sell, your attitude and your hunger to succeed.

If you're confident on the phone, commercially minded and motivated by hitting targets, this is an opportunity to develop your sales career in a growing industry.

The Role

You'll manage customer enquiries from initial conversation through to closing the deal, making sure each customer receives the right advice and a great experience along the way.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Handling warm sales leads: Speaking with customers who have enquired about solar panels and battery storage, understanding their needs and identifying opportunities to make a sale.
- Understanding customer requirements: Asking the right questions to establish what customers are looking for, their property requirements and their reasons for considering solar.
- Developing tailored solutions: Helping customers explore suitable solar and battery storage options based on their requirements, using inhouse software to help design systems.
- Closing sales: Confidently presenting solutions, overcoming objections, answering questions and turning enquiries into successful sales.
- Following up opportunities: Keeping in touch with customers, managing your pipeline and ensuring potential sales don't go cold.
- Building relationships: Creating trust with customers, communicating clearly and delivering a positive experience throughout the sales process.
- Working towards targets: Taking ownership of your performance, consistently working towards individual and team sales targets, and looking for ways to improve results.
- Managing customer enquiries: Keeping accurate records and using internal systems to track conversations, progress opportunities and manage follow-ups.
- Working as part of a team: Sharing ideas, learning from colleagues and contributing to a motivated, high-energy sales environment.

About You

We're looking for someone with genuine sales ability, a positive attitude and the drive to make things happen.

You might already be working in sales, or you could be looking for an opportunity to take your sales career in a new direction. Experience in solar or renewable energy isn't necessary we'll teach you the products and technical knowledge you need.

You'll ideally have:
- A confident, outgoing personality and the ability to build rapport quickly.
- A natural ability to sell, influence and persuade.
- A strong desire to achieve and exceed sales targets.
- Confidence speaking with customers over the phone and guiding conversations towards a sale.
- The resilience to handle objections, overcome setbacks and keep pushing forward.
- A proactive approach to following up leads and maximising every opportunity.
- A commercial mindset, with an understanding of the importance of converting enquiries into revenue.
- Good organisational skills and attention to detail.
- Confidence using computers and the ability to learn new systems quickly.

Previous sales experience is beneficial, particularly in a target-driven environment, but we're more interested in your attitude, personality and ability to sell than your knowledge of the solar industry.

Shift patterns:

Rota A 4 x days 8am-5pm, plus 1x late shift 11am - 8pm

Rota B 4 x days 8am-5pm, 1 x weekend day 9am - 3pm every other weekend

Rotating each week

What's on Offer?
- 30 days' annual leave plus bank holidays.
- Excellent uncapped commission structure
- Private medical cover with Aviva.
- Death in Service cover worth four times your salary with Zurich.
- Six months' paid maternity leave after one year of service.
- Paid paternity leave after one year of service.
- Salary sacrifice pension, matched up to 6%.
- Full training on solar, battery storage products and the sales process.
- Ongoing training and development opportunities.
- The opportunity to develop your sales skills within the growing renewable energy sector.

title: Account Manager
description:
Account Manager

Location: Huddersfield

Salary: Competitive

Job Type: Full Time

Purpose of the Role:

The Account Manager is responsible for the overall success, performance and growth of a portfolio of parcel locker clients. Acting as the senior operational and commercial lead for assigned accounts, the Account Manager will ensure client satisfaction, delivery performance, contractual compliance, profitability and long-term relationship development.

Supported by an administration and helpdesk function, the Account Manager will coordinate internal resources to ensure seamless delivery of deployment and project activities across the client portfolio.

The role requires ownership of client performance from onboarding through to ongoing operational support, ensuring Brand Link consistently delivers against client expectations and strategic objectives.

Key Responsibilities:

Client Relationship Management
- Act as the primary senior point of contact for assigned parcel locker clients.
- Build and maintain strong client relationships at operational and strategic levels.
- Conduct regular service review meetings and business update meetings.
- Manage client expectations and ensure agreed service levels are achieved.
- Identify opportunities to strengthen client partnerships and increase account value.
- Lead contract review discussions and support contract renewals and extensions.
- Manage escalations and ensure timely resolution of client concerns.

Account Ownership & Performance
- Take full ownership of the operational and commercial performance of assigned accounts.
- Monitor key performance indicators (KPIs) and service level agreements (SLAs).
- Ensure account profitability is maintained through effective resource planning and cost control.
- Produce performance reports and account dashboards for both clients and internal stakeholders.
- Identify risks, issues and trends that may impact service delivery.
- Develop and implement improvement plans where performance falls below expectations.

Operational Coordination
- Oversee all parcel locker related activities for assigned clients, including:
- Installations
- Reactive works
- Relocations
- Upgrades
- Electrical and civils works
- Site surveys
- Coordinate activities across:
- Operations
- Project Management
- Helpdesk
- Administration
- Warehouse
- Logistics
- Supply Chain
- Ensure client requirements are translated into achievable operational plans.

Helpdesk & Administration Leadership
- Provide direction and support to the helpdesk and administration teams supporting assigned accounts.
- Ensure client queries, service requests, incidents and escalations are managed effectively.
- Monitor response times and service performance.
- Maintain high standards of communication and customer service.
- Ensure all administrative records, trackers, reports, permits and account documentation remain accurate and up to date.

Commercial Management
- Support budgeting, forecasting and revenue planning activities.
- Monitor account profitability and identify opportunities for margin improvement.
- Review quotations and variations associated with account activities.
- Support invoicing activities and ensure commercial processes are completed accurately.
- Identify additional revenue opportunities through service enhancements and project opportunities.

Continuous Improvement
- Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and customer experience.
- Drive process improvements across client accounts.
- Support the implementation of new systems, procedures and technologies.
- Share best practice across the wider account management and operations teams.

Health, Safety & Compliance
- Promote and maintain a strong health and safety culture.
- Ensure all activities are delivered in accordance with company policies and statutory requirements.
- Support the review of RAMS, permits, and compliance documentation where required.
- Escalate any compliance concerns immediately.

Key Skills, Qualifications & Experience:

Essential
- Proven experience in Account Management, Operations Management or Client Services.
- Experience managing major customer accounts within logistics, facilities management, infrastructure, retail rollout, technology deployment, or parcel locker operations.
- Strong commercial awareness and financial understanding.
- Excellent stakeholder management skills.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities and projects simultaneously.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Advanced Microsoft Office skills, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.

Desirable
- Experience working within parcel locker, logistics, field service, retail deployment, or facilities management sectors.
- Knowledge of civils and electrical delivery environments.
- Experience managing helpdesk or customer support functions.

To Apply

If you feel you are a suitable candidate and would like to work for Principle Global, please do not hesititate to apply.

title: Account Manager Paid Socials
description:
An exciting opportunity has arisen for a Paid Social Account Manager to join a Leeds-based creative business working with an impressive portfolio of household names across beauty, retail and FMCG.

This is a fantastic opportunity for a social media specialist who understands that effective social goes beyond content and clicks. Working as part of an insight-led team, you'll help clients connect social activity to wider brand strategy, audience engagement and commercial growth, bringing together paid, organic and influencer activity to deliver meaningful results.

The Role

You'll take ownership of the day-to-day management of a portfolio of client accounts, acting as a key point of contact and building strong, trusted relationships with clients.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Managing paid social campaigns across Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok and Pinterest, ensuring activity is aligned with client objectives and wider marketing strategies.
- Coordinating paid, organic and influencer activity to deliver cohesive, insight-led social campaigns.
- Acting as a primary client contact, presenting content plans, campaign ideas and performance reports, and providing strategic recommendations.
- Monitoring campaign performance against KPIs, analysing results and identifying opportunities to optimise activity and improve ROI.
- Briefing creative and studio teams on campaign assets, content requirements and creative development.
- Managing influencer relationships from initial research and selection through to campaign delivery and fulfilment.
- Attending client meetings and external photoshoots where required.
- Contributing research, audience insights and ideas to support client growth and new business opportunities.

You'll have the opportunity to take real ownership of your accounts, influence campaign direction and help clients understand how effective social activity can support their wider commercial ambitions.

About You

You'll have experience in a client-facing social media, paid social or digital marketing role, ideally within a creative, digital or integrated agency environment.

You'll bring:
- Around three years' experience in social media or digital marketing, with hands-on paid social campaign management experience.
- Practical experience using platforms such as Meta Ads Manager, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, TikTok and Pinterest.
- Confidence managing client relationships, presenting ideas and communicating performance insights.
- Strong analytical skills, with the ability to interpret campaign data and turn findings into actionable recommendations.
- Experience briefing creative teams and coordinating campaign delivery across multiple stakeholders.
- An understanding of how paid, organic and influencer activity can work together to achieve wider marketing objectives.
- A proactive, organised approach, with the confidence to manage competing priorities and take ownership of your accounts.

You'll be curious about what drives audience behaviour, comfortable working with data and passionate about delivering social campaigns that make a measurable difference.

The Package
- Salary: £30,000-£35,000, depending on experience
- Hybrid working
- 25 days' annual leave plus bank holidays
- Enhanced pension
- Regular company socials
- Learning and development opportunities
